provenance: Original synthetic material created for deterministic repository QA; no exam-provider or learner text is included.

scope.boundarySamples: Exact UTF-16 span, fixed skill ID, category, and hard-grammar flag regression only.
scope.essaySamples: Full-length structured-input and pipeline fixtures only; no gold IELTS band or certified language-quality label.
scope.cycleSamples: Canonical schema, archive, and deterministic evidence-gate scenarios; no live model output.

limitations: AI-generated IELTS bands are estimates, not official IELTS results.
This corpus has not been adjudicated by certified IELTS examiners and cannot establish scoring accuracy.
Open-response model quality and the 95 percent generation-quality target require a separately versioned human-labelled evaluation run.
Passing deterministic fixtures does not certify accessibility conformance or production deployment reliability.
